sections.heading: 2 Melchizedek
sections.body: *Translated by Samuel Zinner; edited by Mark Mattison (Other Gospels Nag Hammadi Initiative)*

sections.heading: 1. The Incarnation of Jesus Christ, Son of God
sections.body:
**1.** Jesus Christ, the Son [of God ...] from [...].

**2.** [...] the aeons, so that he could [travel through] all of the aeons, and [peer] into each of the aeons, the nature of each aeon, concerning what [type] it is, and that he could clothe himself with sonship and goodness as with a garment.

**3.** O brother, [...] their end [...].

sections.heading: 2. His Life, Death, and Resurrection
sections.body:
**1.** And he will [reveal to them] the truth [...]. [...] proverbs [...].

**2.** [... at] first in parables [and enigmas ...].

**3.** [... when he] declares these, Death will be distressed and grow angry, not only him, but also his [companion] archons who govern the world, and the principalities and powers, the goddesses and the gods, with the [arch]angels, even the [...].

**4.** [...] every [...] world ruler [...] about him and about [...] and [...].

**5.** [...] they will [...] concealed [mysteries ...].

**6.** [... scandal] from [...] the All.

**7.** They will [... on account of] this, while the [righteous will] rush to bury him.

**8.** [They will] call him “the Evil One” and “the [impure] violator of the Law,” but he [will rise from the] dead [on] the [third] day [...].

**9.** [...] and [...] them [...] the holy disciples.

sections.heading: 3. The Revelation of the Savior
4. Gamaliel Invokes Divine Beings through Jesus Christ
sections.body:
**1.** I [am Gamal]iel.

**2.** I have come to [rescue] the assembly of the [children] of Seth, because they number more than [thousands of] thousands [and ten thousands] of ten thousands [of aeons, forever and ever. Amen].

**3.** O nature of [all aeons, A]BA[BA AI]AIAI ABABA,

**4.** O S[elf-Generat]ed God of [...],

**5.** O action [of all natures, Mother] of the aeons, [B]arb[elo],

**6.** O firstborn of [the aeons], Aithops Doxomedon Dom[edon],

**7.** O owner of lives, Jesus Christ,

**8.** O head leaders, lights, powers, Harmozel, Oroiael, Dav[eithe], Elel[eth],

**9.** and you, radiant deathless aeon, Pigeradamas,

**10.** and you, the kind God of the righteous worlds, Mirocheirothetou,

**11.** I invoke you all by means of Jesus Christ, Son of God.

**12.** He is the one I preach, given that [he] who exists in truth [among those who in truth] exist has [visited him ...].

sections.heading: 5. The High Priest, Sacrifices, and Baptism
sections.body:
**1.** [... those who] exist not, Abel Bar[uch, so that] you [as a gift could be given] the understanding [of the] truth, (which is) that he comes [from the] nation of the high priest who is [over] thousands [of thousands] and [ten thousands] of ten thousands of the aeons.

**2.** The hostile [spirits] are [unaware] of him, as well as of their own (impending) destruction.

**3.** But that is not all: I have come to [reveal] the truth to you [...] among [the brethren].

**4.** He made himself part [of the] live [sacrifice], together with your progeny.

**5.** He [offered the sacrifice for the] All, [because cattle] are not [what] you will offer up [for sins] of unfaithfulness, [and for] what is ignorant, and (for) all the sinful [acts] that they [commit], because those do [not] arrive to [the Father of the All ... the faith ...].

**6.** [... world ...] world [...] to be [baptized ... in the] waters [...], because the waters [above ...].

**7.** [...] whoever is baptized [...], however, [baptize yourself] in the waters [below ...] while he is coming to [...] mighty [... baptism] as they [...] on [...] by [...] of the [...].

**8.** Pray for [the progeny of the] archons and of [all] the angels, including [the] seed (that) emanated [from the Father] of the All [...].

**9.** [...] the whole seed from the [...].

sections.heading: 6. The Real Adam and Eve
sections.body:
**1.** [There] from the [seed were] generated [gods and angels] and humans [and demons].

**2.** Each [nature], those in [heaven, and] those on the earth, and [those] under [the earth...].

**3.** [...] the nature of the women [...] among those dwelling in the [...] were fettered with [several ...].

**4.** [This, however], is [neither] the real Adam, nor the real Eve, [because when they ate] of the tree [of knowledge], they treaded on [the cherubim] and on the seraphim [bearing the flaming sword].

**5.** The ruler of the world and [his archons set off to meet with the bride] of Adam [who dwelt with him], and they were [polluted by her].

**6.** When, [however], they had generated progeny from the archons with [their worldly entities, the ones] who belong to [...].

**7.** [... light ...] and the females with the [males, the ones who] dwell with [him ... concealed] from all natures.

**8.** [Even the ones] who from him will obtain the [ ... will reject] the archons, because [they] have become deserving [... deathless] and [mighty ...] and [mighty ...and] mighty [... human] progeny [... disciples ... likeness].

**9.** And [...] from the [light ...] holy [...], because [from the] beginning [...] a seed [...].

**10.** [...] I, however, will remain silent [...], because we [are the brethren who have] descended from the living [generations].

**11.** [Revelations] will be [disclosed to] you [by] the [elect progeny] of Adam, [that is, Abe]l, Enoch, N[oah ...], [...]chi [...] you, Melchized[ek, priest] of God, [the Most High, ...] the ones who have [become deserving ...] women [...].

sections.heading: 7. The Final Battle and the Destruction of Death
sections.body:
**1.** These two chosen ones will not be generated, not [at] any time, nor [in] any place.

**2.** Whenever they might be generated [by] their foes, by their friends, by outsiders, and their own relations, by the [wicked] and the righteous, [every] hostile nature, regardless of being seen or unseen, will [rise up] together with those who dwell in heaven, those [on] the earth, and those under the earth.

**3.** They will wage [war ...] every one, because [they exist], regardless of being in the [... holy], even [...] are a multitude [...] with a [...] them [...].

**4.** These, however, with the [...] every [one] will [...] these will [...] by each blow, [even in] sicknesses.

**5.** These will be punished by being imprisoned in other forms.

**6.** The Savior, however, will remove the other ones, and they will conquer everything, [not] by their mouths and speech, but by the actions they will perform.

**7.** [He will] destroy Death.

sections.heading: 8. The Commissioning of Melchizedek
sections.body:
**1.** [As I have done], reveal to others also [these matters], which I was directed to reveal to you, but [what] is secret, reveal it to none, except when [it is revealed] to you to do so.

**2.** And [I], Mel[chizedek], I arose [immediately], and I began to [glorify] God, [the Most High ...].

**3.** [...] that I might rejoice [...] while he is [moving ...] alive [...].

**4.** [I said], I [...] and I [... as a sacrifice].

**5.** [And I] will never stop, not [now and not ever], O Father of the [All, because] you have shown mercy to me, and [you have sent] the angel of light, [Gamaliel], from your [aeons, so that he would] reveal to me [...].

**6.** When he arrived, he [caused] me [to be lifted up] from ignorance, and from the fructifying process of death to life, because I possess a name, I being [Melch]izedek, the priest of [God], the Most High.

**7.** I [know] that I am [the image of] the authentic high priest of God, the Most High, even [...] the world, because it is [not] a small [matter that] God [...] as he [...] and [... the angels] who [abide on the] earth [...] is the sacrifice of [...], the one whom Death deceived.

**8.** When he [died], he fettered them [with] the natures that mislead [them].

**9.** Yet he brought forward sacrifices [...] of the animals [...].

**10.** I have delivered them over to Death [...], and the angels and the [...] demons [...] living sacrifices [...].

**11.** I have offered myself as a sacrifice to you, together with those who belong to me (and) to you as well, O God, Father of the All, together with those you love, who originated from you, who are holy and [living].

**12.** And (in accord) with the [perfect] laws, I shall utter my name, [now] and forever, when I receive baptism among the living and holy [names], even in the [waters]. Amen.

sections.heading: 9. Melchizedek Praises Divine Beings
sections.body:
**1.** [Holy], holy, holy are you, O [Father of the] truly existent ones, [together with those who] do [not] exist, Ab[el Bar]u[ch], for[ever] and ever. Amen.

**2.** Holy, holy, holy [are you, who exist before Zaraz]az, [forever and] ever. Amen.

**3.** Holy, holy, [holy are you, Mother of the] aeons, Ba[r]belo, forever and ever. Amen.

**4.** [Holy], holy, holy are you, [first]born of the aeons, [Doxo]medon [... forever] and ever. Amen.

**5.** [Holy, holy], holy are you, [Akra]man, [for ever and ever]. Amen.

**6.** [Holy, holy], holy are you, [commanding leader, light in the first] aeon, [Harmozel, forever] and ever. [Amen].

**7.** [Holy], holy, [holy are you], leader, light [of the aeons], Oriael, for [ever and ever]. Amen.

**8.** Holy, [holy, holy are you], leader [of the aeons, man of light, Daveithe], forever [and ever]. Amen.

**9.** Holy, [holy, holy are you], commanding [leader, Eleleth ...] aeons [... commanding leader, Pigerada]man, [forever and ever]. Amen.

**10.** [Holy], holy, [holy] are you, good [God of] the [righteous] worlds, [great] Meirochei[rothetou, for]ever and ever. [Amen].

**11.** [Holy], holy, holy are you, commanding [leader of the All], Jesus Christ, [forever and ever]. Amen.

sections.heading: 10. Confess Him
sections.body:
**1.** [... prophecy] and [...].

**2.** Blessed is [whoever makes confession, but whoever will not confess] him [...] now [...] will come to pass for [him ...] fear and [...] fear and [...] distress [...] encompassing [him ...] in the place where [there is] a great darkness [...]

**3.** [...] and several [...] appear [...] there [... appear ...].

sections.heading: 11. Divine Messengers
sections.body:
**1.** [...] and [...] they were clothed with [...] every [...] there [...] and [...] like [...] those [...] woes.

**2.** They [allowed me to hear] their words [...], and they spoke to me: “[Greetings, Mel]chiz[ed]ek, [Priest] of God, [the Most High].”

**3.** They spoke as though [...their] mouths [...] in the All [...] and [...].

**4.** [... he] misled [...] he [...], even his [sacrifices and his] worship ceremonies, [and his ...] faithfulness and his prayers.

**5.** They [sacrificed animals], they [...] those who belong to [him ...] beginning [...].

**6.** [As for me], however, [they spoke to me, saying: “Be not] troubled, because [this priesthood] you fulfil, [and which is] from [... with the deceptive] schemes [of] Satan [...] they [...] his doctrines [...] because your [thoughts ...] of this age [...].”

**7.** [...] exist [in ...] mis[lead ...].

**8.** [...] and some [...] and [...] he handed them over to [...] and [...] and you [...].

**9.** [...] cast [him ...] so that you [...] now [...] by him [...] beneath [...].

[Page 23 is blank]

**10.** [...] because [what] is above [...].

sections.heading: 12. The Death and Resurrection of Christ
sections.body:
**1.** [...] me.

**2.** And [...] you hit me [with the reed].

**3.** You cast me [...] fall.

**4.** And [you crucified me] beginning at the third hour [of the Sabbath] Eve until [the ninth hour].

**5.** And after [these events, I rose] from among the dead [...].

**6.** [...] emerged from [...] to me [...].

**7.** [...] my eyes [beheld ... they] found none [...] me [...].

sections.heading: 13. Conclusion
sections.body:
**1.** [... they] greeted [me ...].

**2.** They said to me: “Be [strong, O Melchiz]edek, great [high priest] of God, [the Most High, because your foes the] archons [waged] war against you.

**3.** You have [won the victory over them, and] they prevailed not over [you].

**4.** [You have] endured and [annihilated] your foes [...].

**5.** [You] will find repose in no [place but in the one that is] living and holy [...] lift up himself [...] flesh [...].”

**6.** [... with] the sacrifices, acting on what is good, fasting with fasts.

**7.** Disclose these revelations to no one who dwells in the flesh, it [being] a non-fleshly reality, unless a revelation is given to you to do so.

**8.** When the brethren of the generations of life had spoken these things, they were taken up to the realms beyond every heaven. Amen.
